title: Season-dependent drought accumulation scales in rainfed Turkish Thrace: code and derived data
description:
Analysis code and derived, analysis-ready data accompanying the article “Season-dependent drought accumulation scales for cropland monitoring and yield modelling in rainfed Turkish Thrace: a Landsat Vegetation Health Index evaluation” (C. Kıvrak and M. Şener, International Journal of Climatology, revised version, manuscript 2684634).

A cropland-masked 30 m Landsat Vegetation Health Index (CORINE class 211, monthly median composite, α = 0.5) is evaluated against SPI and SPEI at 1-, 3-, 6-, 9- and 12-month accumulation scales across seven districts of Turkish Thrace for 1985–2024. Ten candidate indices are scored on four complementary criteria over one identical complete-case sample (n = 1,183), with selection uncertainty from a two-way block bootstrap, seasonal-window selection with paired bootstrap differences, nested leave-one-year-out categorical agreement, district fixed-effects yield panels with wild cluster bootstrap inference, a per-scene compositing and mask sensitivity analysis, a station homogeneity screen, and a multi-resolution aggregation test.

Running python code/verify_headline_numbers.py reproduces the headline results from the files in data/: SPEI-3 consensus rank score 40/40 with r = 0.521, SPEI-9 34, SPI-3 33, bootstrap selection frequency 67.7 %, and Heidke skill score 0.253. Version 1.1.0 accompanies the revised manuscript; the primary vegetation series is now the monthly median composite, the maximum-NDVI composite of v1.0.x is retained for comparison, and the per-scene Landsat table, the seasonal-window, yield-panel and homogeneity analyses and the revised figures are added (see CHANGELOG.md).

Licensing: the code in code/ is released under the MIT licence; the derived data in data/ are released under CC BY 4.0. The underlying raw records from the Turkish State Meteorological Service (MGM) and the Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) are not redistributed and remain subject to those agencies' terms — see LICENSE-DATA.md.
